propositions: Mapped project keys that are syntactically valid but do not exist or are not visible to the bridge bot cause ACLI failures deep in fan-out during reconciliation instead of failing at entry
The legacy_default project is resolved verbatim without validation, causing unbound/legacy tickets to route to invisible or wrong projects with no write guards
The reconcile pass must validate all projects it could touch (mapped keys, legacy_default, and query_project fallback) are visible to the configured backend before any outbound mutation
The preflight validation must be gated on Cloud backend configuration and reuse existing transport infrastructure (AcliClient._direct_rest_get) without new retry logic or subprocess calls

A preflight failure (missing project or transport unavailable) must abort the pass before reconcile_once is called and return an OPERATIONAL_FAILURE PassResult with an actionable message naming the offending key
The validation helper must be reusable and importable for both the reconcile preflight and ticket 9702 bridge fsck diagnostic without inlining
